column2: SELECT c.relname AS name,c.relkind::text AS kind,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,c.relpersistence::text AS persistence,c.relrowsecurity::text AS rls,c.relforcerowsecurity::text AS force_rls,c.relreplident::text AS replica_identity,c.reloptions::text AS options,c.relispartition::text AS partition FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S','f') ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname AS relation,a.attnum::text AS ordinal,a.attname AS name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,a.attnotnull::text AS not_null,a.attidentity::text AS identity,a.attgenerated::text AS generated,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expression,coll.collname AS collation,a.attisdropped::text AS dropped FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_collation coll ON coll.oid=a.attcollation WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND a.attnum>0 ORDER BY 1,a.attnum

SELECT c.relname AS relation,k.conname AS name,k.contype::text AS type,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,false) AS definition,k.condeferrable::text AS deferrable,k.condeferred::text AS initially_deferred,k.convalidated::text AS validated,k.conislocal::text AS is_local,k.connoinherit::text AS no_inherit FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.relname AS relation,i.relname AS name,pg_get_indexdef(x.indexrelid) AS definition,x.indisunique::text AS unique,x.indisprimary::text AS primary,x.indisvalid::text AS valid,x.indisready::text AS ready,x.indislive::text AS live,x.indimmediate::text AS immediate FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=x.indrelid JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid=x.indexrelid WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.relname AS relation,t.tgname AS name,t.tgenabled::text AS enabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,false) AS definition,t.tgdeferrable::text AS deferrable,t.tginitdeferred::text AS initially_deferred,p.proname AS function,fn.nspname AS function_schema FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND NOT t.tgisinternal ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.relname AS relation,k.conname AS constraint_name,p.proname AS function,t.tgenabled::text AS enabled,t.tgtype::text AS type,t.tgdeferrable::text AS deferrable,t.tginitdeferred::text AS initially_deferred FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid LEFT JOIN pg_constraint k ON k.oid=t.tgconstraint WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND t.tgisinternal ORDER BY 1,2,3,5

SELECT p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result,l.lanname AS language,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,p.provolatile::text AS volatility,p.prosecdef::text AS security_definer,p.proleakproof::text AS leakproof,p.proisstrict::text AS strict,p.proparallel::text AS parallel,p.proconfig::text AS config,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS function_definition,p.prosrc AS function_body FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE p.pronamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.relname AS relation,p.polname AS name,p.polpermissive::text AS permissive,p.polcmd::text AS command,ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN r=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(r) END FROM unnest(p.polroles) r)::text AS roles,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) AS using_expression,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) AS check_expression FROM pg_policy p JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=p.polrelid WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT c.relname AS name,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,false) AS view_definition FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('v','m') ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname AS name,format_type(s.seqtypid,NULL) AS type,s.seqstart::text AS start,s.seqincrement::text AS increment,s.seqmin::text AS minimum,s.seqmax::text AS maximum,s.seqcache::text AS cache,s.seqcycle::text AS cycle FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.seqrelid WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.typname AS name,t.typtype::text AS kind,format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) AS base,t.typnotnull::text AS not_null,t.typdefault AS default_expression FROM pg_type t WHERE t.typnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND t.typtype<>'c' AND t.typelem=0 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor) AS grantor,x.privilege_type AS privilege,x.is_grantable::text AS grantable FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(n.nspacl,acldefault('n',n.nspowner))) x WHERE n.oid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT c.relname AS relation,CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor) AS grantor,x.privilege_type AS privilege,x.is_grantable::text AS grantable FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,acldefault(CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN 'S'::"char" ELSE 'r'::"char" END,c.relowner))) x WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S','f') ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT c.relname AS relation,a.attname AS column_name,CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,x.privilege_type AS privilege,x.is_grantable::text AS grantable FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(a.attacl) x WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor) AS grantor,x.privilege_type AS privilege,x.is_grantable::text AS grantable FROM pg_proc p CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) x WHERE p.pronamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

SELECT pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole) AS owner,CASE WHEN d.defaclnamespace=0 THEN 'GLOBAL' ELSE n.nspname END AS scope,d.defaclobjtype::text AS kind,CASE WHEN x.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(x.grantee) END AS grantee,pg_get_userbyid(x.grantor) AS grantor,x.privilege_type AS privilege,x.is_grantable::text AS grantable FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(d.defaclacl) x WHERE d.defaclnamespace IN (0,(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema())) AND d.defaclrole IN ((SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema())),(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user)) ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,6

SELECT r.rolsuper::text AS superuser,r.rolinherit::text AS inherit,r.rolcreaterole::text AS create_role,r.rolcreatedb::text AS create_db,r.rolcanlogin::text AS can_login,r.rolreplication::text AS replication,r.rolbypassrls::text AS bypass_rls,has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CONNECT')::text AS database_connect,has_database_privilege(current_database(),'CREATE')::text AS database_create,has_database_privilege(current_database(),'TEMP')::text AS database_temp,has_schema_privilege(current_schema(),'USAGE')::text AS schema_usage,has_schema_privilege(current_schema(),'CREATE')::text AS schema_create FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname=current_user

SELECT c.relname AS relation,pg_has_role(c.relowner,'USAGE')::text AS owner_membership,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'SELECT')::text AS select_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'INSERT')::text AS insert_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'UPDATE')::text AS update_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'DELETE')::text AS delete_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'TRUNCATE')::text AS truncate_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'TRIGGER')::text AS trigger_priv,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'REFERENCES')::text AS references_priv FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.rolname AS role,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()),'USAGE')::text AS schema_usage,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()),'CREATE')::text AS schema_create,(SELECT count(*)::text FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND c.relkind IN ('r','p') AND has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,TRIGGER,REFERENCES')) AS accessible_tables,(SELECT count(*)::text FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()) AND has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE')) AS executable_functions FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.rolname AS role,r.rolsuper::text AS superuser,r.rolbypassrls::text AS bypass_rls,r.rolcreaterole::text AS create_role,r.rolcreatedb::text AS create_db FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname<>current_user AND pg_has_role(current_user,r.oid,'MEMBER') ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.evtname AS name,e.evtevent AS event,e.evtenabled::text AS enabled,e.evttags::text AS tags,n.nspname AS function_schema,p.proname AS function,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) AS function_definition,p.prosecdef::text AS security_definer FROM pg_event_trigger e JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=e.evtfoid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.extname AS extension,pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid) AS object FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_extension e ON e.oid=d.refobjid WHERE d.refclassid='pg_extension'::regclass AND d.deptype='e' AND ((d.classid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.objid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()))) OR (d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass AND d.objid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema()))) OR (d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.objid IN (SELECT oid FROM pg_type WHERE typnamespace=(SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname=current_schema())))) ORDER BY 1,2
